name: cg_exchange_tickers
description:
Trading pairs on one spot exchange from CoinGecko (exchanges/{id}/tickers): base, target, last price, volume, spread and trust score per pair.
Returns {name, tickers: [{base, target, last, volume, converted_last, converted_volume, bid_ask_spread_percentage, trust_score, trade_url, ...}]}; first page only.
Inputs (* required): id* (string, CoinGecko exchange id such as binance or kraken).
For the venues of one coin across exchanges use cg_coin_tickers.
Example: {"id": "binance"}
